ModMetaData.name: RimUtinni: Assailant Salvage
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
CRYPTOFORGE_HARVEST_RETIRE_1 step 1 — owned RUT_ ThingDef replacements for the 22 salvage props formerly cited to the donor mod "Vanilla Quests Expanded - Cryptoforge" (VQE_*) in design/Jawa/art/SALVAGE_PALETTE.md. Same gameplay stats and function as the donor originals (a citation swap, not a redesign) with entirely owned art and defNames — the donor mod is being retired outright per the owner's "retire-after-harvest" ruling (2026-09-11), and Workshop art is not ours to ship.
These are frozen-ancient-ship set dressing: airlocks, a shielded turret and autocannon (plus their busted/jammed/forced variants), a landmine, a ship terminal + bank, a transmitter and landing beacon, a floor heater, a wargaming table, a blueprints bench, a frozen cryptosleep pod and a ruined hospital bed. They are staged here as standalone content, not yet wired into any map generation — the frozen first-impact complex they were originally harvested for (ASSAILANT_DUNGEON_BUILD_1, the Assailant dungeon) is separately blocked on a joint owner+BENCH creative-lock-in session and is not this item's scope.
